That budget is often enough for ordinary photos, but it can remove small characters from receipts,"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" tables, diagrams, and long screenshots. DSH Vision Tiler gives each local region its own image budg"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"et while preserving a complete, auditable view of the source."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **100% geometric coverage:** coverage tiles are audited against every source pixel.
- **Overlappin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"g seams:** text and shapes that cross a tile edge remain visible in a neighbour.
- **Content-aware c"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"uts:** document mode moves horizontal seams toward low-ink areas.
- **Dense-region review:** an opti"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"onal 512×512 detail crop supplements, never replaces, base coverage.
- **Bounded batches:** large ti"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"le sets are returned in model-safe batches.
- **Traceable output:** each tile carries source coordin"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ates, role, batch state, coverage, and a conservative token cap.
- **No native image build:** v0.2.3"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" uses pure JavaScript plus bundled WebAssembly, avoiding `sharp`/libvips conflicts inside DSH Web."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Requirements: DeepSeek Harness, a vision-capable DSH model profile, and Node.js 22 or later."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Pinned GitHub release:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"No `allow-build` entry is required. 2. Apply EXIF orientation and "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"reject images above the 100-million-pixel safety limit.
